observerImu.hardwareModelStatus: Unidentified OEM vehicle inertial sensor exposed through Dataspeed FCA DBW; do not substitute NovAtel specifications.
observerImu.rateBasis: Both June 7 2024 bags: approximately 50 Hz after the existing affine receiver-clock conversion.
observerImu.covarianceEvidence: First recorded Imu message has all-zero angular/linear covariance (unknown by ROS definition), and orientation_covariance[0]=-1 (no orientation).

lateralSimulation.interpretation: Engineering per-sample independent Gaussian priors on the existing 100 Hz synthetic grid, not certified covariance or OEM specifications. Retained for continuity; not a native-50-Hz interpolation/noise-correlation model.
lateralSimulation.basis: Calibration-drive seconds 1-40 robust second-difference scatter proxies are approximately 0.04842 m/s2 and 0.0008474 rad/s; dynamics, quantization and temporal correlation contaminate these proxies. Gyro prior is deliberately larger.

referenceGnssIns.identityBasis: Recorded INSCONFIG imu_type=41 plus NovAtel CONNECTIMU enumeration. E1 enclosure is consistent but not uniquely identified by the enum.
referenceGnssIns.reportedModelConflict: CTS 25-14 Table 1 says PWRPAK7-E2 and gives E2 random walks; adjacent Figure 2(a) says PwrPak7D-E1. Use recorded IMU identity for these 2024 bags.
referenceGnssIns.specificationScope: E1-class/G320N reference IMU specifications; not specifications of /vehicle/imu/data_raw. Bias instability is not turn-on bias or a hard error bound.
referenceGnssIns.positionErrorPriorStatus: Optional conservative RTK-fixed simulation prior, not a guarantee; actual GNSS updates use recorded quality/covariance. Float, multipath and outage need separate scenarios.

frontLidar.modelStatus: Reported by UMN CTS 25-14; bag verifies 64 rings and 1024 columns, not hardware generation.
frontLidar.rangeErrorPriorStatus: Nominal scenario scale based on the UMN sensor table; not scan-matching pose covariance or an all-target accuracy guarantee.

wheelSpeed.interpretation: Use the existing separate-drive effective per-wheel radii and lag coefficients, not unloaded tire radius or measured physical latency.

extrinsics.interpretation: Retain existing empirical output-point/frame calibrations. Do not invent mounting translations, orientations or physical delays. Stored INSCONFIG has no exported translations/rotations; absence is not proof of zero installation offsets.

timing.interpretation: Zero added delay is a nominal synthetic assumption only. Receiver/header clock scale is approximately 1.0909; rates must be computed in the receiver clock. Offline interpolation does not create independent 100 Hz sensor data.
